articles.summary: NEW YORK — Shares of Cipher Digital Inc. climbed nearly 10% Thursday as the former Bitcoin mining company, now aggressively pivoting to high-performance computing and AI infrastructure, continued to draw bullish bets from investors betting on its long-term hyperscale data center ambitions.
articles.title: Cipher Digital Stock Surges 9.7% as Bitcoin Miner’s Pivot to AI Data Centers Ignites Investor Excitement
